title: Disappearing & Misplaced Garments
root_cause: Paper tags detach in washing drums or extraction process; no visual proof of intake.
financial_impact_annual_inr: ₹2.5L - ₹5L per store loss in damage compensation
proposed_crm_solution: AI Photo Garment Intake + Heat/Wash-Resistant Barcode & RFID Tagging

title: Pre-Existing Stain & Damage Disputes
root_cause: No timestamped high-res photo audit log at POS during garment pickup or dropoff.
financial_impact_annual_inr: Severe brand reputation loss, 1-star reviews on Play Store & Google
proposed_crm_solution: POS Camera Integration with AI Stain & Defect Detection

title: Franchise Cash Skimming & Royalty Evasion
root_cause: Store staff process cash orders offline without entering them into POS.
financial_impact_annual_inr: 10-15% revenue leakage to HQ in uncollected royalties
proposed_crm_solution: IoT Hardware Machine Relay Lockout (Machine turns on ONLY when POS order active)

title: Driver Mismanagement & Sub-Optimal Pickup Routes
root_cause: Drivers use uncoordinated routes, miss time windows, and lack OTP bag verification.
financial_impact_annual_inr: 30-40% inflation in driver fuel & labor costs
proposed_crm_solution: AI Cluster Driver Routing + Live WhatsApp OTP Handover

title: App Download Dropoff & Friction
root_cause: Users resist downloading a dedicated app for bi-weekly laundry bookings.
proposed_crm_solution: WhatsApp Native Conversational Booking & Payment Flow
